changelog: Fixes the crowded homepage hero on phones and tablets, including the Jellyfin Android app. Carousel indicators wrap below Play and More Info without a horizontal scrollbar. Rotation and arrow controls have separate space, actions wrap on narrow screens, and the hero grows for long titles and larger text. Preserves existing navigation, playback, carousel settings, and desktop layout.
description: A unified cinematic Jellyfin Web customization with a profile-forward login screen, Plex-inspired theme, and rotating library-driven home hero.
name: Cinematic UI
overview: Cinematic login and home experience for Jellyfin Web
